lines.speaker: Lachlann the Lost
lines.text: That bastard tyrant, Praetor Draven! He's taken my family hostage! They're being held somewhere beyond these gates. I never thought he would stoop this low! I sent for reinforcements... but... it's been so long... I must get through the gate... The keys... where are the blasted keys? I... I believe those cowards took them...
